# UCO Bank Specialist Officer (SO) Recruitment 2026: An In-Depth Comprehensive Guide to Notification, Eligibility, Salary, and Career Progression

The banking sector in India is rapidly evolving, integrating advanced technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and sophisticated Cyber Security frameworks to protect financial assets and streamline operations. Recognizing the critical need for specialized talent in these domains, UCO Bank has officially released the UCO Bank Specialist Officer (SO) Recruitment 2026 notification. This massive recruitment drive is aimed at selecting top-tier IT professionals for the prestigious positions of Manager AI/ML Engineer and Manager Cyber Security.

This extremely detailed and comprehensive article breaks down every single aspect of the UCO Bank SO Recruitment 2026. From a detailed analysis of the official notification to an in-depth breakdown of the job profile, salary structure, career progression, syllabus, and strategic preparation tips, we leave no stone unturned. If you are an IT professional aiming to secure a lucrative and respectable career in a leading Public Sector Bank (PSB), this guide is your ultimate roadmap.

## 1. Overview of UCO Bank SO Recruitment 2026

UCO Bank, a premier nationalized bank under the Government of India, has announced the recruitment of Specialist Officers in Scale II. The recruitment specifically targets highly skilled professionals in the fields of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Cyber Security. As digital banking becomes the norm, the role of these specialists is not just supportive but central to the bank's operational integrity and future growth strategies.

The official advertisement (Advt No.: HO/HRM/RECR/2024-25/COM-01) outlines a total of 20 high-value vacancies. Candidates selected through this rigorous recruitment process will be inducted as Managers (Scale II), playing pivotal roles in modernizing the bank's technological infrastructure and safeguarding it against emerging digital threats.

## 2. Key Highlights and Important Dates

Keeping track of the recruitment schedule is the first step towards a successful application. Below is a detailed timeline for the UCO Bank SO Recruitment 2026:

- Online Apply Start Date: 29 August 2026
- Online Apply Last Date: 18 September 2026
- Last Date for Fee Payment: 18 September 2026
- Exam Date: To Be Notified Later
- Admit Card: Before Exam
- Result: Will Be Updated Soon

Candidates are strongly advised not to wait for the last date and to complete their application and fee payment well in advance to avoid last-minute server congestion.

## 3. Vacancy Details and Categorization

The recruitment drive aims to fill 20 specialized positions. The vacancies are distributed across two highly sought-after IT domains:

- Manager AI/ML Engineer: 10 Posts
- Manager Cyber Security: 10 Posts

While the total number of vacancies is 20, the competition is expected to be intense due to the specific skill set required and the attractiveness of the Scale II Managerial position in a nationalized bank.

## 4. Detailed Eligibility Criteria: Educational Qualifications

The educational requirements for these specialized roles are strict, ensuring that only the most technically proficient candidates are selected.

Manager AI/ML Engineer:
- Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in IT/CS/AI & ML/Data Science with 3 Years experience.
- Alternatively, M.C.A./M.Tech/M.E in IT/CS/AI & ML/Data Science with 3 Years experience.

Manager Cyber Security:
- A B.E./B.Tech Degree in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Software Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering or Equivalent Degree in above specified disciplines with minimum 50% marks in Any Stream from Any Recognized University in India.
- Alternatively, M.C.A./M.Tech/M.Sc in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/ Software Engineering/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering or Equivalent Degree in above specified disciplines with minimum 50% marks in Any Stream from Any Recognized University in India.

## 5. Experience Requirements: A Crucial Benchmark

Because these are Scale II Managerial positions, practical industry experience is mandatory. Theoretical knowledge alone is insufficient.

- Manager AI/ML Engineer: A minimum of 3 years of relevant post-qualification work experience is strictly required. The experience should ideally involve working with large datasets, developing predictive models, and deploying ML algorithms in production environments.
- Manager Cyber Security: A minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in Cyber Security, Information Security, Network Security, or related domains. Hands-on experience in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing (VAPT), security operations center (SOC) management, and incident response is highly preferred.

## 6. Age Limit and Relaxations

The age criteria are designed to target young, experienced professionals who can serve the bank for a long tenure.

- Minimum Age: 25 Years
- Maximum Age: 35 Years
- Cut-off Date for Age Calculation: 01 August 2026

Age Relaxations are applicable as per Government of India norms (Read Post Wise Age Limit & Relaxation On UCO Bank Official Website).

## 7. Application Fee Structure

The application process involves a non-refundable application fee/intimation charge, payable online.

- General, OBC, EWS Category: ₹ 850/-
- SC / ST, PwBD Category: ₹ 175/-

Payment Modes Accepted (Online):
- Debit Card
- Credit Card
- Internet Banking
- IMPS
- Cash Card / Mobile Wallet

## 8. Detailed Job Profile: Manager AI/ML Engineer

The role of a Manager AI/ML Engineer at UCO Bank is highly dynamic and central to the bank's digital transformation. Day-to-day responsibilities include:
- Predictive Modeling: Developing models for credit risk scoring, fraud detection, and customer churn prediction.
- Natural Language Processing (NLP): Implementing chatbots and virtual assistants for enhanced customer service.
- Data Infrastructure: Collaborating with data engineers to ensure robust data pipelines and data quality.
- Algorithm Deployment: Translating complex mathematical models into scalable, production-ready code.
- Strategic Insights: Analyzing vast amounts of transactional data to provide actionable business insights to the higher management.

## 9. Detailed Job Profile: Manager Cyber Security

A Manager Cyber Security acts as the digital shield of the bank. The responsibilities are critical and involve:
- Threat Intelligence: Monitoring global cyber threat landscapes and proactively adjusting the bank's defenses.
- Vulnerability Management: Conducting regular VAPT on the bank's web applications, mobile apps, and internal network infrastructure.
- Incident Response: Leading the rapid response team during a suspected data breach or cyber-attack.
- Compliance & Auditing: Ensuring the bank's digital infrastructure complies with RBI guidelines on cyber security framework.
- Security Architecture: Designing and implementing robust security architectures for new digital banking products.

## 10. Comprehensive Salary Breakdown (Scale II)

As a Scale II Officer (Manager), the selected candidates will enjoy a highly lucrative compensation package in line with the IBA (Indian Banks' Association) guidelines.

- Basic Pay: Starting basic pay in Scale II as per the latest bipartite settlement.
- Dearness Allowance (DA): Revised quarterly based on the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
- House Rent Allowance (HRA): Varies depending on the place of posting (Metro, Urban, Semi-Urban). Alternatively, bank leased accommodation may be provided.
- City Compensatory Allowance (CCA): Applicable in specific major cities.
- Transport Allowance: For commuting between residence and office.
- Special Allowance: A fixed percentage of the basic pay.
- Total Gross Salary: Very attractive and highly competitive in the banking industry.

## 11. Perks, Benefits, and Allowances

Beyond the monetary salary, UCO Bank offers exceptional perks that make a banking career highly stable and rewarding:
- Medical Facilities: Comprehensive medical insurance and reimbursement for the employee and dependents.
- Leave Fare Concession (LFC): Travel allowance for vacations anywhere in India.
- Concessional Loans: Highly subsidized interest rates on housing loans, vehicle loans, and personal loans.
- Provident Fund (PF) & National Pension System (NPS): Robust post-retirement financial security.
- Festival Advance: Interest-free advance during major festivals.

## 12. Career Growth and Promotions Hierarchy

Joining as a Manager (Scale II) puts you on an accelerated career path within the bank's IT vertical. The typical hierarchy is:
1. Manager (Scale II)
2. Senior Manager (Scale III)
3. Chief Manager (Scale IV)
4. Assistant General Manager (Scale V)
5. Deputy General Manager (Scale VI)
6. General Manager (Scale VII)

Promotions are merit-based and often involve internal examinations and performance appraisals. IT specialists can also transition into broader management roles or head specific technology divisions.

## 13. The Selection Process: A Multi-Stage Evaluation

The selection process is rigorous, designed to assess both technical prowess and managerial capabilities.
1. Online Examination
2. Group Discussion
3. Personal Interview
4. Final Selection

The official notification details the exact structure, marking scheme, and weightage of each stage.

## 14. In-Depth Syllabus Analysis: Professional Knowledge (AI/ML)

For the AI/ML post, the Professional Knowledge section will dominate the online exam. Key topics include:
- Machine Learning Algorithms (Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement Learning)
- Deep Learning (Neural Networks, CNNs, RNNs)
- Data Preprocessing and Feature Engineering
- Big Data Technologies (Hadoop, Spark)
- Statistical Modeling and Probability
- Python/R Programming for Data Science

## 15. In-Depth Syllabus Analysis: Professional Knowledge (Cyber Security)

For the Cyber Security post, candidates must master:
- Network Security (Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs)
- Cryptography (Symmetric/Asymmetric, Hashing, PKI)
- Web Application Security (OWASP Top 10)
- Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing methodologies
- Information Security Standards (ISO 27001, NIST framework)
- RBI Guidelines on Cyber Security in Banks

## 16. Syllabus for General Sections

- Reasoning Ability: Puzzles, Seating Arrangement, Syllogism, Blood Relations, Coding-Decoding, Inequality.
- Quantitative Aptitude: Data Interpretation, Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Arithmetic Word Problems.
- English Language: Reading Comprehension, Cloze Test, Error Spotting, Para Jumbles, Fill in the Blanks.

## 17. Preparation Strategy: How to Crack the Exam

- Master Your Domain: Since the majority of marks are allocated to Professional Knowledge, ensure your technical fundamentals are rock solid. Revise core engineering subjects.
- Practice Mock Tests: Time management is critical in banking exams. Take full-length mock tests to simulate exam conditions.
- Stay Updated with Banking Tech News: Read about recent cyber attacks in the financial sector or how AI is revolutionizing banking. This will help immensely in the Interview and GD.
- Focus on Accuracy: Negative marking is usually applicable. Do not guess blindly.

## 18. Recommended Books and Resources

- For AI/ML: Books on Machine Learning with Python/R, Data Science fundamentals.
- For Cyber Security: Security+ Study Guide, Certified Ethical Hacker materials.
- For Reasoning & Quants: Standard competitive exam preparation books.
- Daily Newspaper: For current affairs and banking awareness.

## 19. Previous Year Cut-off Trends and Exam Difficulty

Specialist Officer exams generally have a moderate to difficult level of questions, especially in the Professional Knowledge section. The cut-offs for general sections are usually lower than probationary officer exams, but candidates must score exceptionally well in their domain specific test. Previous trends indicate that a strong performance in the professional knowledge section provides a safe margin for interview shortlisting.

## 20. Step-by-Step Guide: How to Apply Online

1. Visit the Official Website: Go to https://uco.bank.in/job-opportunities.
2. New Registration: Generate a Registration Number and Password.
3. Fill the Application Form: Carefully enter educational qualifications, experience details, and personal information.
4. Upload Documents: Upload a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per the specified dimensions and file size.
5. Pay Application Fee: Use the integrated payment gateway to remit the fee.
6. Submit and Print: After successful payment, submit the form and take a printout of the application form for future reference.

## 21. Critical Mistakes to Avoid During Application

- Mismatched Information: Ensure the name and date of birth exactly match your certificates.
- Blurry Uploads: A blurry photograph or unreadable signature will lead to outright rejection.
- Last-Minute Rush: Applying on the last day (18 September 2026) often leads to transaction failures.
- Incorrect Category: Selecting the wrong category cannot be changed later and will lead to disqualification if valid proof is not provided.

## 22. Conclusion and Final Advice

The UCO Bank SO Recruitment 2026 is a golden ticket for AI/ML engineers and Cyber Security experts to build a secure, prestigious, and highly rewarding career in the public sector banking domain. The combination of an excellent salary, unmatched job security, and the opportunity to work on large-scale, impactful technological projects makes this an unmissable opportunity. Start your preparation today, focus on your core technical strengths, and approach the examination with confidence and strategic planning. Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 18 September 2026!
